enps.title: eNPS — Employee Net Promoter Score
enps.intro: Two questions, one answer per campaign. Your answer is anonymous: management only reads distributions and unnamed comments, and only once enough colleagues have answered.
enps.q1: On a scale of 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend your organisation as a good place to work?
enps.q2: What is the main reason for your score, and what improvement would make you recommend our organisation more?
enps.reasonPlaceholder: Your reason, then the improvement that would make you recommend the organisation more…
enps.saved: Your answer has been saved. Thank you!
enps.closed: This campaign is closed: your answer can no longer be changed.
enps.missingScore: Choose a score from 0 to 10 for question 1.
enps.missingReason: Answer question 2: the reason for your score and the improvement you would like.
enps.loadFailed: Could not load the eNPS. Reload the page.
enps.saveFailed: Your answer could not be saved. Try again.
enps.noCampaign: No campaign is open at the moment.
enps.detractorsHelp: Dissatisfied employees, unlikely to recommend the organisation as an employer.
enps.passivesHelp: Fairly satisfied employees, but not engaged in recommending it.
enps.promotersHelp: Very satisfied employees, keen to recommend the organisation.
enps.formulaHelp: The result ranges from −100 (all detractors) to +100 (all promoters). Passives count in the total but neither add nor subtract.
enps.notPublished: Not published yet: {{n}} answer(s), at least {{min}} are needed to protect anonymity.
enps.noData: No eNPS answer for this campaign.
